kids: Watch the Christmas Tree Lighting and Santa's arrival
Ride the train and browse the Tree Gallery
Visit Santa during the weekend open house
site: The Casements and Rockefeller Gardens, 25 Riverside Drive
Tree lighting and Santa's arrival at 6 PM on Friday
about: The city's announcement calls the gala one of Ormond Beach's most cherished holiday traditions and says the historic winter home of John D. Rockefeller is transformed for the season.
Friday night lists holiday entertainment, food trucks and train rides alongside handmade crafts, the Gift Shoppe and the Tree Gallery.
A Gourmet Shop and ice cream round out the Friday schedule, which runs from 5 to 9 PM.
Weekend hours are noon to 5 PM on Saturday and Sunday, with Santa visits from noon to 3 PM.
The Daytona Beach Area CVB also lists the gala under its holiday events, with the same December 4 to 6 dates and The Casements phone number.
The city's Casements news feed shows that the building closes for Thanksgiving and holiday decorating before the gala weekend.
On Thanksgiving weekend the city also lists the 68th Annual Birthplace of Speed Gaslight Parade on November 27 and an antique car show at Fortunato Park on November 28.
faq: When is the Casements Christmas Gala?
December 4 to 6, 2026: Friday from 5 to 9 PM and Saturday and Sunday from noon to 5 PM.
When does Santa arrive?
At 6 PM on Friday, December 4, during the Christmas Tree Lighting in Rockefeller Gardens.
Can kids visit Santa on the weekend?
Yes. The city lists visits with Santa from noon to 3 PM on Saturday and Sunday.
Who presents the gala?
The Casements Guild.
Is there food?
The city lists food trucks, sweet treats, a Gourmet Shop and ice cream.
Where do I get more information?
Call The Casements at (386) 610-0649, or open the flyer linked from the city page.

kids: Take a holiday photo with Santa
Visit the petting zoo and bounce houses
Get a Golden Ticket for the 3 PM prize drawing
site: Hawks Park, 1108 S. Ridgewood Ave, Edgewater
Golden Ticket winners announced at 3 PM
about: The festival's name comes from Wilkie's Pest Control, one of the three presenting partners named on the event page.
Strong4You.org's page lists free games, live local entertainment, face painting and local vendors alongside the food trucks.
The Golden Ticket prizes are donated by local businesses and sponsors, and every child who attends gets a ticket at the festival.
The page lets visitors add the event to Google Calendar or export it to Outlook.
A regional family calendar also lists the festival with free admission, and the page's last update came on November 10, 2026.
On November 28, Edgewater holds Light Up the Night at the same park, from 6 to 9 PM, according to a regional family calendar.
The festival is the second annual edition, with the city of Edgewater as a partner.
faq: What time is the Wilkie Wonka Christmas Festival?
Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 11 AM to 5 PM.
Where is it?
Hawks Park, 1108 S. Ridgewood Ave, Edgewater.
What is the Golden Ticket?
Every child receives one for a chance to win donated prizes, with winners announced at 3 PM.
Is Santa there?
Yes, the page lists holiday photos with Santa.
Are there rides or animals?
The page lists a petting zoo and bounce houses.
Who runs it?
Strong4You.org with the City of Edgewater and Wilkie's Pest Control.
